"""Verify frozen import routing and launch the single owned V154 controller."""

import os
import subprocess
import time
from pathlib import Path

import psutil
from train_directional_bank_trial import guard, read, ref, save

repo = Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic')
root = repo / '.cache/quality-20261103/V154-robust-spectral-v1'
plan_path = root / 'plan-v1.json'
plan = read(plan_path)
guard(plan)
assert not (root / 'controller.claim').exists()
work = Path(plan['work'])
env = dict(os.environ, PYTHONPATH=f'{work}/src:{work}/scripts',
           OMP_NUM_THREADS='2', OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS='1', MKL_NUM_THREADS='1',
           HF_HUB_OFFLINE='1', TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE='1', CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES='0',
           CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=':4096:8')
argv = [str(repo / '.venv/bin/python'), '-P', plan['runner']['path']]
check = subprocess.run(argv + ['--help'], cwd=work, env=env,
                       capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30, check=True)
assert 'MSE and robust delivered-RGB' in check.stdout
for name in ['robust_spectral_objective.py', 'delivered_spectral_objective.py', 'noisy_objective.py']:
    assert ref(repo / 'scripts' / name)['sha256'] == ref(work / 'scripts' / name)['sha256']
save(root / 'objective-readiness-v1.json', {
    'status': 'pass-frozen-controller-import-and-independent-objective-tests',
    'plan': ref(plan_path), 'unit_tests_observed_terminal': '27 passed in0.80s',
    'unit_tests_source': ref(repo / 'tests/test_robust_spectral_objective.py'),
    'objective_source': ref(repo / 'scripts/robust_spectral_objective.py'),
    'frozen_import_argv': argv + ['--help'], 'frozen_import_stdout': check.stdout,
    'frozen_PYTHONPATH': env['PYTHONPATH'],
    'launch_preflight': dict(ref(Path(__file__)), text=Path(__file__).read_text()),
    'new_neural_forwards': 0, 'new_parent_DINO_forwards': 0, 'new_noise_draws': 0,
    'scope': 'Independent dense DFT/projection values and full two-image output adjoints for both robust epsilons across four CFAs and zero/positive proxies; exact V153 RGB-MSE values/gradients,tiny-complex/zero finite derivatives,unsampled-color/flat-target penalties,support gradient and invalid epsilon checks. Tests observed in terminal, not an invented stdout log. Launch uses absolute frozen paths and un-resolved repository Python executable.',
})
with (root / 'controller-v1.log').open('x') as log:
    child = subprocess.Popen(argv + ['controller', str(plan_path)], cwd=work, env=env,
                             stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                             start_new_session=True)
    owner = {'pid': child.pid, 'created': psutil.Process(child.pid).create_time()}
save(root / 'controller-launch-v1.json', {
    'owner': owner, 'argv': argv + ['controller', str(plan_path)],
    'recorded_unix_UTC': time.time(), 'readiness': ref(root / 'objective-readiness-v1.json'),
    'launcher': dict(ref(Path(__file__)), text=Path(__file__).read_text()),
})
print('Launched once:', owner)
